description: F03 Terminal aggregate sizing slice. Rust terminal-core now owns viewport dimension clamping, configured-history capacity and user-resize total-row clamping in a platform-neutral aggregate. The three Microsoft ScreenSizeLimits contracts are exercised directly against that product owner.

entries.notes: TerminalLayout clamps rows/columns to 1..SHRT_MAX using the same negative, zero and oversized vectors as Microsoft.
TerminalLayout clamps configured history to zero or remaining SHRT_MAX capacity and exposes the resulting total row count.
User resize clamps backing rows at SHRT_MAX while preserving configured history, so shrinking the viewport restores the original total exactly as the Microsoft regression requires.
